verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is Grafana Cloud's Adaptive Telemetry suite. It 'automatically identifies the data worth your attention and aggregates the rest' to cut telemetry costs by up to 80%, which addresses data-volume and cost management. However, it is described as automatic aggregation rather than deliberate developer control of trace or log sampling, and retention tiers are never mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit configurable trace sampling (head/tail) controls, log sampling or drop rules, configurable retention periods or tiers for Loki/Tempo, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
